breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly rejected the continuum Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions and instead specified 'A Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) model will be used.' This aligns with the ground truth's guidance that kinetic/DSMC methods should be used for Kn~5, not continuum no-slip Navier-Stokes. The inconsistency is fully resolved.
